description: 5 should-trigger + 5 should-not-trigger. Should-trigger covers the three host surfaces — SSH posture, firewall baseline, unattended upgrades. Should-not-trigger covers the neighbours: application-code vulnerability work (security-audit), application authorization (authz-review), cloud provisioning (terraform, aws-infrastructure), container images (docker) and adjudicating the resulting posture (operational-readiness).

set up a default-deny firewall baseline on the VPS
how do I get automatic security patches on this box?
should I install fail2ban on the host?
